rejected_matches.reason: 'whether correct' (borderline-type phrase, not a family word)

notes: Question words excluded at these positions: false (and 虚假/假/假的), statement (陈述/表述), contain (包含), previous (上一), yes/no. 'truthful' is kept in the honest family (it names honesty, not the truth value); bare true/truth/fact/correct/accurate words are under borderline. Generic speech verbs (claim, assert, say, 声称) and implication words (imply, 暗示) were not treated as candidates. preans_slot0 and preans_slot3 are dominated by template and yes/no tokens; their few families are small.
